relationships.subject: Morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that morphine activated TLR4 by HMGB1 but not MD2

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Up-regulations of TLR4/p65 NF-κB and proinflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α) in BV2 cells were prevented by inhibiting and knocking down TLR4.

relationships.subject: PAG microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: morphine increased the phosphorylation of NR1 and NR2B by inducing TLR4-mediated microglia inflammation

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Knocking TLR4 out of PAG by Lentivirus-GFP-TLR4 shRNA reversed these changes and relieved OIH.

key_findings: Morphine activates microglial TLR4 via HMGB1 (not MD2) in PAG, driving proinflammatory cytokines.
Microglial inflammation phosphorylates neuronal NR1/NR2B; PAG TLR4 knockdown relieves opioid-induced hyperalgesia.
